### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **19** documentable anchor(s).

**27** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e`.

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **42** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f7371cd62cf4fcba6769fea8dd05d108d701faa8` — the merge of head `5ac557e5ee88b430a8f9cbb3e47d24427c65ab77` into base `39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f7371cd62cf4fcba6769fea8dd05d108d701faa8 && git checkout f7371cd62cf4fcba6769fea8dd05d108d701faa8
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e 5ac557e5ee88b430a8f9cbb3e47d24427c65ab77 && git checkout -B drift-repro 39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e && git merge --no-ff 5ac557e5ee88b430a8f9cbb3e47d24427c65ab77

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 39951d2a26590ff93226d3c0cf4ecfdc4136031e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5ac557e5ee88b430a8f9cbb3e47d24427c65ab77`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts-unknown-package.test.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-drafts-unknown-filter.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-drafts-unknown-type.test.ts + packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts (`refuseUnknownMetaListType`, `metaTypeIsLive`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts `getMetaItems` package branch (L10801) and its disabled-package filter (L10720-10750), packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts (L505, L724), packages/client/src/index.ts (`listDrafts`, L2199), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packageSurfaces.ts and StudioDesignSurface.tsx (the 24 `listDrafts` call sites), packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts (`ListDraftsResponseSchema` docblock), scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs (`CATEGORIES`)

Read on the head tree via `git show 5ac557e5:PATH` and `git diff origin/main...5ac557e5`; nothing checked out. Inputs: card #29180 body and its three comments (triage, claim, dev report), PR #29295 body, file list, comments (docs-drift, review claim), and the head's check-runs. The PR body's account was not the evidence; the tree was.

**Merge state.** `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 5ac557e5` on today's `origin/main` (`39951d2a`, 44 commits past the base `104cd1a5`) returns a tree with no conflict, so the dev's "protocol.ts changed elsewhere" note is a clean three-way merge; the net diff against `origin/main` is the nine files above (+325/-4).

**Check-runs on the head.** 48 check-runs, all completed: **35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure, 0 cancelled** (final tally read after the eight `Test Core` shards, `Build Core`, the `Type Check` and `Lint` families finished). Green among them: `Check Changeset` (carries the ADR-0087 disposition gate), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Test Core` 1-8, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Live E2E UI`. The skipped runs are the UI build/test family and opt-in harnesses whose path filters this diff does not reach. These conclusions are the derived-gate verdicts; nothing was run locally.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set — `GET /meta/_drafts?type=X` (both transports).** Before: any `type` string narrowed the repo query and answered `200 {"drafts":[]}` when nothing matched. Now: `refuseUnknownMetaListType(p, type)` runs before `listDrafts` — static spelling contract (`unrecognisedMetaTypeRefusal`), then the live `getMetaTypes` set folded through `canonicalMetaUrlType`, fail-open when the listing is unreadable or the protocol lacks `getMetaTypes`. A name the list door refuses is refused here with the identical thrown error, shaped by each transport's own catch (`handleRouteError` / `errorFromThrown`). Read in `meta-item-read-gate.ts` L2676-2690 and L2706-2726. **Narrowing; right** — it is the card's acceptance ("as `GET /meta/dashbord` does") and no second copy of the vocabulary exists: the same function `GET /meta/:type` (rest L664, runtime L2221) and `GET /meta/diagnostics?type=` (rest L375) call. Plural spellings pass (`dashboards` → `canonicalMetaUrlType` fold), pinned by both transport tests.
2. **Accept set — `listDrafts({ packageId })` in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.** Before: an unmatched `packageId` answered empty. Now: when the filtered result is empty, `packageIsInstalled(this, packageId)` is asked — the identical rule the diagnostics sweep applies to its `package=` filter (`protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts` L261-272), with a draft bound to the package (any type) as proof enough, read BEFORE the disabled-package filter so an uninstalled or disabled package with real draft rows is served, and fail-open on an unreadable or shapeless listing. **Narrowing; right.** Two break attempts failed: (a) a disabled package with nothing pending — `getMetaItems` deliberately never filters `package` records ("the Packages page must list disabled packages", protocol.ts L10726), so it is listed and keeps its `200 {"drafts":[]}`; (b) a Studio-created scope-less base — registered through `POST /api/v1/packages`, so it is among the `type: 'package'` records the listing returns. The type-filtered empty path costs one extra type-less `repo.listDrafts({ packageId })` read, only on the empty answer; acceptable.
3. **Public surface — `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`.** `packageIsInstalled` gains `export`, and `DraftsHost` gains `getMetaItems`; `index.ts` re-exports neither `protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts` nor `protocol-drafts.ts` (verified: no `export *` and no named export from either), so the published surface does not move. `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.listDrafts`'s declared signature is unchanged; only its docblock grows. **Right; `Metadata-protocol: none` holds** — `packages/spec` is untouched and no authorable key, value or type moves.
4. **Protocol-internal callers.** `protocol-save-door-refusals.ts` L505 and L724 call `this.listDrafts({ type: 'datasource' | 'object' })` with no `packageId`, so the package rule never reaches them; the `type` rule lives in the transports and they bypass it with known types. **Unaffected; right.**
5. **Consumers.** `packages/client` `listDrafts` forwards `packageId`/`type` and unwraps the envelope — a 400 now rejects where it resolved `[]`. In `ui/`, 24 call sites: every one pairs `packageId` from the Studio package switcher (installed packages) with a `type` in {`view`,`hook`,`object`,`app`,`permission`,`metaType`} and, except `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` L4855 (inside a `try`), carries `.catch(() => [])`; each paired `client.list(type, { packageId })` already refuses the same type names. **No consumer refusal the paired read did not already make; the dev's reading holds.**
6. **Not changed.** Unknown query-parameter NAMES on `_drafts` (e.g. `?package=`) stay ignored — the dev names it out of scope and the card's own `?package=` wording is a slip (the route reads `packageId`). Correct scoping.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/29180-drafts-unknown-filter.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime` — the three packages whose behaviour the diff moves, and no others. Line-initial `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` in both the changeset and the PR body. Per the Post-Task Checklist level rule a `none` kind takes **`patch`**, and a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition — present: the **BREAKING** banner, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (a `CATEGORIES` member, L147 of the gate), and the migration ("The remedy": fix the misspelled value; `GET /api/v1/meta/types`, `GET /api/v1/packages`). `Check Changeset` (which runs `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base`) is green on the head. **Level and declarations match what the diff publishes.** `Clause-②:` **no (narrowing)** — confirmed by reading: nothing widens; two previously-200 request shapes become 400 on both transports.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev `open_questions[0]` — runtime dispatcher twin edited beyond the claim's file-surface wording.** Answered: **A, keep — right.** The rest route's own `[#23214]` comment at `meta-collection-routes.ts` L465-466 ("the runtime dispatcher's twin refuses the same names") and the gate's "Both transports" docblock (`meta-item-read-gate.ts` L2661-2667) bind the `_drafts` pair; the type verdict lives in `@objectstack/rest`, so it cannot be placed in `listDrafts` without a second copy, which the claim forbids. Dropping the hunk would leave a dispatcher-only host at `200 {"drafts":[]}` for the typo — the defect, half-fixed. The claim's "and/or the `_drafts` route in `packages/rest`" named the door; the twin IS that door on the other transport. Deviation accepted.
- **Dev `open_questions[1]` — PR assignee/reviewer not set (order forbids MCP writes).** Outside the contract; no bearing on the verdict. Escalated to the seat: set via relay if wanted, otherwise leave unset.
- **Dev deviation — ui consumer tests run as a 4-file subset.** Accepted: those tests mock the client, so the server change cannot reach them; the consumer reading in ①.5 is the evidence that matters.
- **`Skills-docs: none`.** Verified: `git grep _drafts` over `content/docs/**`, `skills/**`, `.claude/skills/**` finds only the maintenance-mount row (`references/api/rest-server.mdx` L228) and the 403 capability citation (`ui/apps.mdx` L455, L461); no page documents the `type`/`packageId` filters. The docs-drift comment is advisory and lists pages by package mention. Holds.
- **Card premise.** Holds against the base tree: `meta-collection-routes.ts` passed `req.query.type`/`packageId` straight into `listDrafts` after the arity check alone; the dev's base-tree ablation (refusal pins red, controls green) is consistent with that reading.
- No `packages/spec` edit, no new error code, no new gate — the claim's three stops are honoured.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-drafts.ts`** — holds. Order of operations is right: the repo read, then the package verdict on the UNFILTERED rows (so a disabled package's drafts count as bound, matching the docblock "a disabled package's drafts still publish and discard"), then the disabled-package projection. The `bound` re-read is only taken when a `type` narrowed the first read, and skipped when it could not change the answer. The refusal reuses the sweep's status, code and sentence family. **Should-fix (doc):** the module header still says "A MOVE, not a redesign. Each function below is the body ... as it stood, re-indented one level and otherwise unedited" and accounts for exactly two imports from `protocol.ts`; `listDrafts` now carries a `[#29180]` hunk and a third import from `protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts`. One sentence noting the #29180 edit keeps the header true for the next reader. Not blocking.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts`** — holds. `export` only; the body is unchanged, the host Pick (`getMetaItems`) is the one member `DraftsHost` adds, typed as the same indexed access on the class, so the call type-checks without a cast.
- **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`** — holds. The host literal adds `getMetaItems: (...a) => this.getMetaItems(...a)` in the closure shape the module header prescribes (a spy set on the instance is still reached); the docblock names the refusal and says the `type` half is the transports', which is true.
- **`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`** — holds. The call sits after the authoring gate, the 501 probe and the arity refusal, inside the `try`, exactly where the diagnostics door (L375) asks the same question; `|| undefined` keeps `type=` (empty) as "no filter" as before; `draftsType` is the one value both the verdict and `listDrafts` see.
- **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`** — holds; the twin mirrors the rest placement (after capability gate, protocol probe, arity), inside the `try` that `errorFromThrown` shapes, and the test pins the drafts body equal to the list branch's.
- **Tests** — `protocol-drafts-unknown-package.test.ts` pins both halves of the rule including the fail-open shapes and the "listing never asked" controls; the two transport tests pin equality with the sibling list door's body for four misspellings, `listDrafts` never called, and the controls in both spellings. `meta-drafts-unknown-filter.test.ts` also pins that a thrown package refusal leaves the rest route at 400. Each is a new file; no existing pin was edited.
- **Scenario the card accepts against** — a typo'd `type` or `packageId` on `_drafts` is refused 400 with the sibling doors' sentence; a known type in either spelling and an installed package with nothing pending keep `200 {"drafts":[]}`. Met on both transports.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: one (stale module header in `protocol-drafts.ts`).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-igicmx`
Reviewed-by: `session_01ADHkmQjPiXgNoSaEpqeGvY`

**VERDICT: PASS**
